repos_data.description: Dynamic agent memory for LLM agents: 7 neuroscience-inspired layers (working, episodic, semantic, procedural) with FSRS spaced repetition and memory consolidation. Zero-dependency TypeScript library, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, Vercel AI SDK middleware. Paper: arXiv 2604.23878 · reproduction packages on Zenodo.
An agent-native teaching OS — a classroom that remembers, for you and your AI. MCP server + self-hosted web app.
